content: <thought>The spectrum shows a strong base peak at m/z 183.045 (intensity 100) and a clear M+2 peak at m/z 185.042 with intensity ≈33 % of the base peak. This ~3:1 M : M+2 ratio is characteristic of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl natural abundances 75.8 %/24.2 %). No ~1:1 M : M+2 pattern (bromine) or ~4 % M+2 (sulfur) is observed. Therefore chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern.
